message: As a parent, I’ve learned that power outages can become unexpected family bonding moments. I remember a time when the lights went out, and we ended up huddled together with flashlights, sharing stories and playing games. It’s a great reminder to prepare ahead of time, so we can keep the fun going even when the power's out! Have you ever made a plan for those little surprises? What’s your favorite way to pass the time during a blackout?
